snippet.title: Raccoon Packer: A Cozy Puzzle Game - Trailer
snippet.description:
Raccoon Packer: Mischievous raccoons bring you the weirdest items to pack. Fit everything perfectly, add the right stickers, then ship it off. A cozy, satisfying packing experience with a touch of chaos.

Wishlist on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4590400/Raccoon_Packer_A_Cozy_Puzzle_Game
